sentence_labels.label: hook
sentence_labels.text: Look at Korea from space at night.

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: The South is blazing with light cities glowing like spilled gold.

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: And then right above it, there's nothing.

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: A black hole the size of England where a country of 26 million people should be.

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: From up there, South Korea looks like an island.

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: That dark country is North Korea.

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: Its founder died in 1994 and officially he's still its eternal leader.

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: Since then, his son and his grandson have run the place like a family business.

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: a country where your radio is fixed to the government station where watching a south korean tv show can

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: get you sent to a prison camp and where kids are taught that their leader family has almost magical powers

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: And here's what makes it truly strange.

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: 80 years ago, North and South were the same country.

sentence_labels.label: explain
sentence_labels.text: Same language, same food, same families.
